title: New hospital building, Brisbane: radiation shielding
workplace: New 10 storey hospital building with a two level basement and rooftop helipad, on an existing hospital campus next to the live hospital, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Lead-lined walls in the imaging rooms
swms.task: Install lead-lined plasterboard and lead sheet to the walls of the imaging rooms, cutting the lead-lined sheets on site.

steps: Work at the upper wall and ceiling line

rules.phrase: the regulator is notified in writing within 7 days
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 395, s 403, s 405
rules.quote: the person must give the regulator written notice within 7 days that the work is lead risk work

rules.phrase: treat it as lead risk work
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 392, s 394, s 402
rules.quote: the process is taken to include lead risk work until the person determines that lead risk work is not carried out in the process
